title.narrative: JapanWorld Bank Program for Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Management in Developing Countries

description.narrative: This TF will operate as part of the Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR). The objective of the Program is to support developing countries in mainstreaming DRM in national development planning and investment programscomma including those related to World Bank country strategies and operations. In doing socomma the Program will strive to connect Japanese and global expertise in DRM with developing countries. The objectives of this Program are in keeping with the GFDRR Partnership Charter and its Strategy 2013-15. The Program will be coordinated with other funds at the disposal of GFDRR to achieve DRM objectives more efficiently and effectively. At the request of the Donorcomma the Trust Fund will further allow such transfer of funds for the Donor's membership contribution to designagted trust funds in GFDRRcomma as may be required to maintain its membership in the GFDRRcomma as per provisions of the Partnership Charter of GFDRRcomma and as long as such Trust Funds are active.
